notes.title: Cross-platform matching support - May,1 2025
notes.content:
We have updated Touhou Gensou Mahjong to v1.2.15a.

[h1] Cross-platform battles are now available![/h1]
We've been working hard on this update, and we're finally able to announce that cross-platform matches between the Switch version of Touhou Gensou Mahjong and other platforms are now available!
Enjoy fantastic mahjong battles on your favorite platform and in your favorite style!

[h1] New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Cross-platform multiplayer support. [/b]
[*] Double-clicking is now treated as the confirmation action in character selection.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of tiles in the pot was not reset during forced consecutive rounds for “Mike Goutokuji” and “Miyoi Okunoda” and during a flowing full house.
[*] Fixed an issue where “Kisume” abilities could stack multiple times.
[*] Fixed an issue where communication synchronization would become out of sync and cause the game to freeze when playing online with CPU characters “Byakuren”, “Hatate”, “Koakuma”, “Lyrica”, “Orin”, or “Tenshi.”
[*] Fixed translation omissions.
[*] Fixed behavior that could cause memory shortages or unnecessary frame drops.
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse pointer display and the actual click location were misaligned when NDI was enabled.
[/list]
[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted POW gauge increase amount. Raised the gauge increase amount for characters with low gauge increase amounts, increased the charge amount in 4-round games, expanded placement corrections, etc.
[*] Relaxed the quotas of some stages in “Adventure”.
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy Touhou Gensou Mahjong.

notes.title: Update 24/11/19 - Private match support via "Lobby Password" feature
notes.content:
Touhou Gensou Mahjong has been updated to v1.2.14.
(2024/11/19 20:48(JST) Corrected description of how to search using “lobby password”.)

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] The list of tables now also shows rooms where a game is in progress (and you can't enter).
[*] The “Lobby Password” function has been added. This is a replacement for the “Private Room” setting that was originally planned. More details to follow.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the ability of “Komachi Onozuka” (extending the “Ippatsu” hand) could be canceled by the opponent's declaration of Pon, Chi, or Kan, even though it was not supposed to be possible.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ability of “Aunn Komano” could be activated when the player was in a concealed hand, even though it was not supposed to be possible.
[*] Regarding the ability of Junko, (1) the number of tiles loaded was different from the description, and (2) it was sometimes cause freeze, so these have been fixed.
[*] The rule settings for the Adventure Mode stages “Dream World -1” and “Underground Passage -2” were different from the descriptions, so these have been fixed.
[*] After playing a game online, if you then played a CPU game (either Free Play or Adventure Mode), an error would occur when trying to make an impossible communication.
[*] Reviewed log output and minimized non-error log output.
[/list]

[h1]About the “Lobby Password” function[/h1]
As an alternative to the conventional game room password, the “Lobby Password” function has been added from this version.
Game rooms with a set “Lobby Password” will not be visible in the normal game room search. Naturally, you will not be able to enter them either.
If you want to enter a room with a “lobby password” set, select the “lobby password” item that has been added to the top page of the Network match, and enter the same “lobby password” that you specified when creating the game room. (The case of the letters and the number of characters are also distinguished.)
When you press OK on the password input screen, it will search for a game room where the “lobby password” matches.

If you want to set up a table that anyone can join, please delete the “lobby password”.

[i]We have confirmed a bug that if you close the “Lobby Password” dialog box by “right-clicking” when entering the “Lobby Password” on the top page of the Network match, you will not be able to click any buttons on the Net Battles page afterwards. We will fix the problem as soon as possible, but for the time being, please click the “Cancel” button in the dialog to cancel.[/i]

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delay in adding the “Private Match” function.
We look forward to your continued support for “Touhou Gensou Mahjong”.

notes.title: Touhou Gensou Mahjong will be available on Thursday, September 19th!
notes.content:
To all the mahjong fans around the world, thank you for waiting. Touhou Gensou Mahjong is now complete!
Thank you very much for all the suggestions for improvement and messages of support on SNS and message boards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/9db344631352388bfc1774e71c823838a6e87592.png[/img]

Steam version of “Touhou Gensou Mahjong” bundles some DLCs, which was sold separately in the consumer version.
[list]
[*] Additional character “ZUN”
[*] Additional character & stage "Unconnected Marketeers" pack
[*] “Touhou Gensou Mahjong 4” BGM Pack
[/list]
Please enjoy to your heart's content!

Also, for about two weeks after the start of release, [b]10% off the regular price[/b] will be available as a sale.
Please take this opportunity to enjoy playing against mahjong players from around the world in “Touhou Gensou Mahjong”!

[h1]Game modes added to the Steam version[/h1]

[h2]Cirno's Mahjong Class[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/2bdfef66f6326bf68ac3bfcfaae91ace8ba1131a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/8ebd49a080e33706afc869baaa22405946859aee.png[/img][/url]　[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/1e8b16236796f5c67c5be62b99bdeb21f8066572.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/345031936c3a6384ac71e1385a97e665838e3459.png[/img][/url]　[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/6e31d9c2c12785c2c6eaedc2e17c42bfeea2ced4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/26164ff379aeee2437ce40f7970ba6d257e1b9b8.jpg[/img][/url]
Let's learn the basics of mahjong with Cirno and her friends. It starts with “7-tiles mahjong”, which is easy to make a winning hand, so even complete beginners can play with peace of mind.


[h2]Adventure[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/7aa53849418131c9f8460582622db25182890d88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/91db1876ac630d6db37b99817a4f6c30488b9820.jpg[/img][/url]　[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/bc56c1c9a8c8d21853262d74e92fdbdab2543c82.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/e44b99b4ce979a40d36567c67d114b146884d775.png[/img][/url]
This is a mode where you start at the Hakurei Shrine and clear “Quota” while visiting various locations in Gensoukyou. As you advance through the stages, the music by Motoi Sakuraba, Takeshi Abo, Hiroyuki Kawada and other legendary artists that was added in the Steam version will be “unlocked” (i.e. made available as BGM for the online match). Please take your time and give it a try.

With this update, we aimed to create a “fun ‘Touhou Gensou Mahjong’ for both individuals and groups”.
We hope you enjoy mahjong at any time to suit the scene.

[h1]Countdown event![/h1]

From September 11th, we will be holding a “countdown” project on the [url=https://x.com/touhou_g_mj/]Touhou Genso Mahjong Twitter (now X) account[/url].
Every day at 7pm(JST), we will be releasing a countdown illustration by an illustrator associated with Touhou Genso Mahjong!

[h1]Added Features[/h1]

[/list]

[/list]
[h1]Other fixes[/h1]

[*]Closed the new songs that appeared in the Steam version once. Please listen to the retail version next time.
[*]Adjusted the table texture of the "Noh Stage". Reduced the vividness and contrast of the background.
[/list]
We will continue to release the demo version for the purpose of testing and debugging until its release, and will continue to fix bugs. However, we will lower the maximum number of users to reduce server load. We appreciate your understanding.
After the release of the final version, we plan to limit the demo version to single-player and focus on the "Adventure" and "Cirno's Mahjong Class" experiences.

[h1]Please help us by sending us your logs[/h1]
We have received several reports of bugs, but the conditions under which they occur are not yet known, and these bugs have not been fully fixed in this patch.
However, log files can be collected on the PC version. If you send us the logs when the bugs occur, we may be able to fix them earlier. We would appreciate your cooperation in sending us the logs if you don't mind.

[h2]How to send logs[/h2]
[h3]Location and file name of the log file[/h3]
The log file is located in "C:\Users\[username]\AppData\LocalLow\DNASoftwares\TouhouGensouMahjong\". (If your startup drive is not C, replace "C:" at the beginning with the name of your startup drive.)
Player.log is the log file of the currently running (or last running) Touhou Gensou Mahjong, and Player-prev.log is the log file of the previous run.

[h3]If a bug occurs[/h3]
If a bug occurs, close the application (if you have not yet terminated Fantasy Mahjong), and then copy the above log file "Player.log" to [url=https://support.mediascape.co.jp/en/contact-product-en?product=191]sent through Mediascape(this game's Publisher)'s support portal[/url]. You can attach files up to 2 MB in the "Inquiry for specified products" form. If the file is large, we would appreciate it if you could Zip it. Please describe the situation in which the bug occurred in the description of your inquiry.

Thank you for your continued support of "Touhou Gensou Mahjong".

notes.title: Update June,14 2024
notes.content:
The demo version of "Touhou Gensou Mahjong" has been updated to v1.2.3.
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]NG word filter is applied to nicknames and game room names. It seems that the correct behavior of Steam is to not filter texts sent by yourself or your friends, but currently you and your friends are also filtered due to the technical specifications. Please be aware of this.
[*]Added support for NDI protocol output of video from a different screen than the game screen.Details are explained below.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed cancel operation being triggered twice by right-clicking when selecting a character in a CPU free game.
[*]Fixed a bug in which when Cirno's ability hit the player themself, the player would be forced to discard their last drawn tile 4 times in the current turn plus three turns. From now on, it is 3 turns forced discards even if themself is frozen.
[/list]
[h1]NDI sending function[/h1]

[h2]What is NDI?[/h2]
NDI (Network Device Interface) is a protocol for transmitting video and audio via LAN. If there are compatible devices or applications, they can exchange video and audio sources with each other via LAN.

[h2]What is NDI support for Touhou Gensou Mahjong?[/h2]
The client can generate video for live relay separately from the video viewed by the players and send it to a broadcasting tool (such as OBS Studio) that supports the NDI protocol.
Before now(include Switch version), it was very time-consuming to prepare a dedicated client for watching the game, set up a room for stream, and then join the game with another client(and account) and so on. With this feature, it is now possible to output video for watching the game and play at the same time with only one PC and one account. This feature will allow you to simultaneously output video for spectators and play a game with minimum of only one PC and one account.

[h2]Preparation[/h2]
NDI-compatible software must be prepared.
D.N.A. Softwares has tested on [url=https://obsproject.com/ja/download]OBS Studio[/url] with [url=https://github.com/obs-ndi/obs-ndi]obs-ndi[/url] installed to check and debug.
Please refer to each site for how to install the software.

[h2]How to enable[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/75610ffea9603db9db83e6f2606fc8701427ef13.png[/img]
In the "Advanced Settings" menu under "My Page" and "Settings", there is an item titled "NDI". When "ON" is selected, a 4-digit number is displayed, which is used to identify the source.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/2a72d38a469cefbc4a2e9a416ce822c9cdc00191.png[/img]
*Screenshots are from OBS Studio + obs_ndi

After turning it on, search for the source in an application that can receive NDI and you will find "thmj-xxxx" (xxxx is a 4-digit number). Note that when you are not playing a game, a dedicated single fixed  picture is displayed; if you start a game(whether you are playing against the CPU or online), you will see the relay screen.

For now, the function is simply to look down on the table from directly above, but we hope to add more features that are useful to streamers, etc., while ensuring fairness in the game. If you have any comments, requests, suggestions, etc. (even if it is difficult to implement all of them), please write them on the forum. We appreciate your comments and suggestions.

[h2]Other Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Audio will not be sent out via NDI. [/b] If you wish to include the sound of the game, please record it separately.
[*]Due to the fact that two screens are generated at the same time, a good machine spec is recommended. Please be careful not to run out of memory.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of "Touhou Gensou Mahjong".

notes.title: Handling of the DEMO version after the Next festival

(Please forgive them if they're slow to respond as they'll be playing mahjong at the same time.)

notes.title: “TOUHOU GENSOU MAHJONG” Steam Demo Version Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/98a3b0643e809f62458e16427689a02b6bc69d79.png[/img]
Thank you for long waiting, the demo of the Steam version of “TOUHOU GENSOU MAHJONG” is now available!
You can also listen to the very best Touhou Arrangements by "regendary composer on video game", Motoi Sakuraba, and Takeshi Abo in this demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/773aead63583ad57a39e2b7d8ec94e1b778c8d9a.png[/img]
This demo version is available both in English and Japanese! Enjoy a un-real mahjong experience with rivals from around the world!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/7c352e1e59073f95a1721e078f7f50394525eba7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/bac6eab8ea8a82a6f53b16b596ef3e5ad8256a36.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/c221d82d1f26235356e55b3c569f72fca61b1dcf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/f5840ed6fdaed12bc6d063247993af31f8b76cb2.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Steam Next Fest![/h1]
During the Steam Next Fest, there will be a streaming broadcast by the staff of “TOUHOU GENSOU MAHJONG”. The developers will each be taking questions from everyone in the chat box. Please join in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444327/fc7bab3c9b3a55ddc87b06e0c06d674fadf9f6e2.png[/img]
